verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own docs let users change the time a connection refreshes each night, which is a user-configurable recurring sync job. The product also runs automatic overnight model rebuilds and advertises 'Proactive alerts & triggers'. These cover only fixed nightly data syncs and vendor-run automation, not general user-defined recurring workflows. missing for 10: user-defined schedules for arbitrary jobs or workflows (e.g., recurring reports, Ari tasks, scenario runs), configurable cadence beyond nightly sync time, documentation of how triggers are set up, independent or hands-on corroboration.
